versions.changelog:
- Added an explicit "Start on APIDot" section for quick-access entry points from ClawHub.
- Refined documentation to highlight how to open APIDot model pages, docs, and dashboard directly.
- No changes to API handling; core skill remains documentation-only.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

Initial release of APIDot Kling 2.6 Motion Control API skill.

- Provides documentation-only guidance for APIDot Kling 2.6 Motion Control workflows.
- No executable scripts, client code, or network activity; contains only `SKILL.md` and notes in `references/api.md`.
- Covers async task flows, task_id usage, polling, and webhook integration for motion transfer and character animation.
- Directs users to official APIDot docs and model pages for up-to-date integration details.
- Emphasizes safe API key handling and security best practices.
